title: The Pale Bell
author: Oscar Zhou
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
